name: Cathedral of Ethiron
desc: The _Cathedral of Ethiron_ is a landmark in [The Maw of Ethiron](location:the_maw_of_ethiron). It is the final destination point of The Eternal Gale's First Floor. Any players who'd want to progress further into the Second Layer must defeat Chaser to continue.
additional_info:
-   There are numerous Apprentice Diver corpses alongside the corpse of a Deepdelver hung on hooks, presumably killed by Chaser.
    -   Some of the Diver corpses bear resemblance to [Lance Leshi](entity:lance) and [Lance's Brother](entity:lances_brother), though it is highly unlikely that they are the same people who are killed.
